name: Perform Cosinor Analysis
description: Performs cosinor analysis on physiological time series data to characterize circadian rhythms.
detailed_description: Performs cosinor analysis on physiological time series data to characterize circadian rhythms.
when_to_use: When you need perform cosinor analysis analysis

parameters.time_data: [Required] Time points of the measurements in hours (array-like)
parameters.physiological_data: [Required] Physiological measurements corresponding to each time point (array-like)
parameters.period: [Optional] Period of the rhythm in hours, default is 24 hours for circadian rhythms (default: 24.0)
